probe_php:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require $argv[1] . '/bootstrap.php';

$mode = $argv[2];
$shape = $argv[3];
$storage = new App\Platform\Storage\PostgreSQLStorage(
    getenv('TEST_DB_HOST'),
    (int) getenv('TEST_DB_PORT'),
    getenv('TEST_DB_NAME'),
    getenv('TEST_DB_USER'),
    getenv('TEST_DB_PASSWORD'),
    getenv('FETCH_ONE_SCHEMA'),
);
$sql = match ($shape) {
    'lookup' => 'SELECT id, payload FROM records WHERE id = :id',
    'bounded' => 'SELECT id, payload FROM records WHERE id >= :id ORDER BY id LIMIT 1',
    'unbounded' => 'SELECT id, payload FROM records WHERE id >= :id ORDER BY id',
    default => throw new InvalidArgumentException('Unknown probe shape'),
};
$read = static function () use ($storage, $mode, $sql): ?array {
    if ($mode === 'one') {
        return $storage->queryOne($sql, ['id' => 1]);
    }
    $rows = $storage->query($sql, ['id' => 1]);

    return $rows[0] ?? null;
};
$row = $read();
if ($row !== ['id' => 1, 'payload' => str_repeat('x', 1024)]) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Unexpected warmup row');
}
unset($row);
$baseline = memory_get_usage();
memory_reset_peak_usage();
$started = hrtime(true);
$row = $read();
$elapsed = hrtime(true) - $started;
$after = memory_get_usage();
$peak = memory_get_peak_usage();
if ($row !== ['id' => 1, 'payload' => str_repeat('x', 1024)]) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Unexpected measured row');
}
echo json_encode([
    'mode' => $mode,
    'shape' => $shape,
    'elapsed_ns' => $elapsed,
    'php_baseline_bytes' => $baseline,
    'php_live_delta_bytes' => $after - $baseline,
    'php_peak_delta_bytes' => $peak - $baseline,
], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), PHP_EOL;
runner_python:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,random,statistics,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
env=dict(os.environ)
assert env.get('TEST_DB_NAME'), 'Set TEST_DB_* for a separate test database'
setup=r'''require 'bootstrap.php'; require 'tests/Integration/PostgreSqlTestDatabase.php'; $db=Tests\Integration\PostgreSqlTestDatabase::fromEnvironment(); $db->create(); $pdo=$db->connect(); $pdo->exec('SET search_path TO "'.$db->schema.'"'); $pdo->exec("CREATE TABLE records (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO records SELECT id, repeat('x',1024) FROM generate_series(1,20000) AS records(id); ANALYZE records"); echo json_encode(['schema'=>$db->schema,'postgres'=>$pdo->query('SHOW server_version')->fetchColumn()]);'''
metadata=json.loads(subprocess.run(['php','-r',setup],cwd=root,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
schema=metadata['schema']
assert schema.startswith('phpunit_') and len(schema)==32
env['FETCH_ONE_SCHEMA']=schema
samples=[]
try:
    jobs=[(mode,shape) for shape in ['lookup','bounded','unbounded'] for mode in ['legacy','one'] for _ in range(7)]
    random.Random(20261023).shuffle(jobs)
    for mode,shape in jobs:
        r=subprocess.run(['php','var/fetch-one-probe.php',str(root),mode,shape],cwd=root,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
        samples.append(json.loads(r.stdout))
    summaries=[]
    for shape in ['lookup','bounded','unbounded']:
        for mode in ['legacy','one']:
            s=[s for s in samples if s['mode']==mode and s['shape']==shape]
            summaries.append({'mode':mode,'shape':shape,'samples':len(s),'median_ms':statistics.median(x['elapsed_ns'] for x in s)/1e6,'peak_php_bytes_max':max(x['php_peak_delta_bytes'] for x in s),'live_php_bytes_max':max(x['php_live_delta_bytes'] for x in s)})
    data={'date':'2026-10-23','base_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'platform':{'php':subprocess.check_output(['php','-r','echo PHP_VERSION;'],text=True),'os':subprocess.check_output(['uname','-sm'],text=True).strip(),'postgres':metadata['postgres']},'fixture':{'rows':20000,'payload_bytes':1024,'index':'PRIMARY KEY (id)','warmup_calls_per_process':1,'measured_calls_per_process':1,'fresh_processes_per_case':7,'random_seed':20261023},'probe_php':pathlib.Path('var/fetch-one-probe.php').read_text(),'runner_python':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'setup_php':setup,'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['src/Platform/Storage/Storage.php','src/Platform/Storage/PostgreSQLStorage.php','src/Platform/Storage/Sql/SqlExecutor.php','examples/document-catalog/src/CatalogRepository.php']},'summaries':summaries,'samples':samples,'limitations':['Zend memory counters exclude native libpq buffers, RSS and PostgreSQL memory.','Both paths use the default buffered PDO PostgreSQL mode and execute identical SQL per case.','Legacy callback reproduces fetchAll then first-row selection without closeCursor, as in the base commit.','PDO PostgreSQL closeCursor is not a guarantee that native result memory is released from cached statements.', 'These are short loopback CLI observations, not HTTP load tests or a worker memory soak.']}
    pathlib.Path('var/fetch-one-measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(summaries,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
finally:
    drop=r'''$p=new PDO('pgsql:host='.getenv('TEST_DB_HOST').';port='.getenv('TEST_DB_PORT').';dbname='.getenv('TEST_DB_NAME'),getenv('TEST_DB_USER'),getenv('TEST_DB_PASSWORD')); $p->exec('DROP SCHEMA "'.getenv('FETCH_ONE_SCHEMA').'" CASCADE');'''
    subprocess.run(['php','-r',drop],env=env,check=True,capture_output=True)
